activity_summary: You looked at the shape and did not add a speech. The five lines are still lists, a banishment, a death, a landing, and a crown handed across. You did not name an uncle, and you did not start a scene.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the sheet as it was.

entities.name: Holinshed, second volume
entities.context: Mentioned in The shape, and no name
